title: A core's own Part History records Tracking turned off and Tracking turned on with its part
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location "Staging Heavy Duty". Logged in as (a) Admin or a default Parts Manager. Data: QAPL-C1 (tracked, Core Charge > 0, so it has a core). Before the run, get the part id of QAPL-C1's core from an API response in the DevTools Network tab (the core has no row on the Inventory list and its Part History page has no on-screen link); if no response exposes it, mark the case Blocked as dev-verified (gap analysis S5-E3 note).
custom_steps:
1. Open QAPL-C1 from /parts/inventory, switch "Track quantities and cost of goods" off and click Save.
  2. Click the QAPL-C1 row's Part History icon and read the newest entry.
  3. Open /parts/history/{corePartId} by address and read the newest entry.
  4. Reopen QAPL-C1, switch tracking on and click Save; then open the part's Part History again.
  5. Reload /parts/history/{corePartId}.
custom_expected:
1. The row reads "Not Tracked" without a reload.
  2. "Tracking turned off" with Staff = the logged-in user and the Date and Time of the save.
  3. The core's page opens (there is no on-screen link to it) and shows its own "Tracking turned off" entry with the same Staff, Date and Time as the part's entry.
  4. The row shows "{n} available" again; the part's newest entry is "Tracking turned on" with Staff, Date and Time.
  5. The core's history adds "Tracking turned on" with the same Staff, Date and Time as the part's entry; its "Tracking turned off" entry is still listed below it.
